item.title: Gautam Gambhir receives lucrative proposal to join Rajasthan Royals in triple role: Report
item.description: India head coach Gautam Gambhir has reportedly been approached by Rajasthan Royals (RR) with a lucrative offer to join the franchise in triple role.
